items.title: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
items.summary: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.

items.title: New York house fire kills six and injures at least nine
items.summary: Six people have died and at least nine others were injured - including three firefighters and two police officers - during a house fire in New York.

items.title: Interest rates hiked to 4% in first increase in over three years
items.summary: Most analysts expected the increase from 3.75% to 4%.

items.title: Henry Nowak's family react as his killer has jail sentence increased
items.summary: Henry Nowak's family say they face a "life sentence of grief" and their "fight for justice is far from over" after his killer's jail term was increased.

items.title: Married at First Sight UK cancelled after BBC revealed rape allegations
items.summary: Channel 4 will reinvest the show's budget in "distinctive new programming" and said sorry again to the women involved.

items.title: PM reviewing decision to give UK military satellite system contract to US firm
items.summary: Andy Burnham must settle a bitter battle on Earth between rival American and European companies over the future in space of a critical UK military satellite system.
